learning.title: Delete the public TCP proxy that Railway database templates create
learning.trigger: Provisioning a Railway Postgres or Redis service from the template.
learning.rule: The database templates create a public TCP proxy for external access. For Postgres that exposes the postgres superuser to the internet. Delete the proxy on both Postgres and Redis (railway tcp-proxy list then delete with the id, service and --yes), confirm both lists are empty and that RAILWAY_TCP_PROXY_DOMAIN is absent from the service variables, and re-check with railway config plan --detailed-exit-code so the program does not re-add it.

Reach the database only through railway ssh -s Postgres -- psql -U postgres, or railway connect Postgres --ssh. Needs a registered SSH key. Never print railway variable list output without jq keys or has(), because it prints values.

verification.requirement: Record both empty lists and the has(RAILWAY_TCP_PROXY_DOMAIN) result false.

learning.boundary: The api service must also have no public domain or TCP proxy: its trusted-proxy CIDR list is private-only and is sound only while that holds.
